title: Harry Turner, UFO-obsessed intelligence chief over Woomera nuclear tests

tellings.quote: There's Woomera test range which um the head of the nuclear division actually in Australia, the joint intelligence organization was a guy named Harry Turner, and he was obsessed with UFOs.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, brings up Woomera, a weapons test range in Australia used for nuclear tests in the 1950s. He says the man in charge of the nuclear side of Australia's Joint Intelligence Organisation, a national spy agency, was Harry Turner, and that Turner was obsessed with UFOs. Michels tells it to link UFO interest to the people watching over nuclear weapons sites.
